  PROBLEM: In test_gate_final_ci_now_green_routes_a_generated_chore_without_the_security_pass, the assertion outputs.get("det_skip_security_pass", "false") != "true" always passes, because the gate script writes this output only when the security pass is required and enabled (AUTOFIX_SKIP_RUNS_SECURITY_PASS=true).
  WHY: The tests give less assurance that generated-chore PRs are routed without triggering the security pass. The source marked this SEVERITY: NIT, which is mapped here to low. The other four reviewers raised the same gap only as a HARDENING_SUGGESTION, not as a finding.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Issue #10183 acceptance criterion 3, "`agents.d/` and `changelog.d/` fragments describe the new path and the switch", and the README variable table row must describe the shipped behavior at the level of detail used for adjacent rows.
  expected_change_site: README.md:186 (the `FINAL_CI_NOW_GREEN_MERGE_ENABLED` row, not-routed conditions list) and changelog.d/10183-final-ci-now-green-merge.md:6 (the paragraph listing the not-routed conditions)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: agents.d/10183-final-ci-now-green-merge.md:4 mentions the generated-chore exemption (GENERATED_CHORE=true), but README.md:186 lists "needs the single-issue security pass while `AUTOFIX_SKIP_RUNS_SECURITY_PASS` is not `true` or the PR has `ai:security-pass-failed`" with no exemption; changelog.d/10183-final-ci-now-green-merge.md:6 repeats the same list without the exemption; gate_final_ci_now_green_merge_route at scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:1894-1910 skips the whole security-pass block when GENERATED_CHORE="true", so a generated chore is routed to deterministic-skip-merge instead of being held; an operator reading the row alone would expect a generated chore to be held. All three sources marked it SEVERITY: NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 looked at this item and chose not to report it, calling it a wording nit: the README wording is still accurate and the agents fragment names the exemption.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
(No findings reported.)
- HARDENING: tests/test_review_autofix_clean_same_head_gate.py test_gate_final_ci_now_green_routes_a_generated_chore_without_the_security_pass, the assertion `outputs.get("det_skip_security_pass", "false") != "true"`
  PROBLEM: The assertion always passes because the test runs with `AUTOFIX_SKIP_RUNS_SECURITY_PASS="false"`, and the gate writes `det_skip_security_pass` only when that switch is "true" (`scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh` line 2174).
  WHY: If the `GENERATED_CHORE` check at line 1895 were removed, a chore would get `det_skip_security_pass=true` with the switch on, and this test would not catch it. Suggested fix: parametrize over ("false", "true"); in the "true" case, assert `outputs["det_skip_security_pass"] == "false"` and that "AUTOFIX_GATE_DET_SKIP_SECURITY_PASS" is not in result.stdout. Estimated lines changed: 5. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
- NOTE: Checked the GENERATED_CHORE exemption and found it correct. It is set to "false" at line 1409 and becomes "true" at line 1439 only after strict checks. The `${GENERATED_CHORE:-false}` default keeps the security-pass check active when that block is skipped. The exemption mirrors the rule at line 1688.
- NOTE: Considered two task gaps and did not report them. The README/changelog omission was judged a wording nit. "The full test suite passes" was judged a validation status, not missing code.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
